scope: End-to-end stress test through consensus-edge selection. Re-estimate CLR reference and candidate selection in each simulated dataset, then reuse all 500 archived data-independent locality-capped subsets and the existing 10J inference engine. Community clustering is not part of this control.
generator: Reuse the declared independent lognormal-intensity/Poisson-recovery generator from the process calibration, but give every provenance label the same equal-study global baseline gene profile. There are no cross-gene latent links and no latent study shifts. Coordinate/BioSample hierarchy and per-run recovery yields remain explicit.
interpretation: These are measurement stress controls, not a marginal-relative-data null and not a graph-wide FDR estimate. A consensus graph in these controls demonstrates susceptibility to the measurement model; it does not identify false edges in the observed graph.
baseline_guard: Before controls, reproduce every one of the 1,000,000 archived edge selections and the observed consensus weights within 1e-12.
